description: Concentric backup agent: scheduled database backups with restore verification
notes: To run the agent as a Windows service (starts at boot, restarts itself, keeps itself
up to date), run this once in an elevated PowerShell (Run as Administrator):
It asks for your license key (portal: Agents -> Add agent) and master passphrase.
The service runs its own copy from C:\Program Files\bckupx, so `scoop update` never
has to stop it. Remove it with `bckupx-agent service uninstall` (keeps your data).
